name: Restaurant Scout
title: Food trend & shoppable content agent
description: Watches TikTok and Instagram for dishes similar to the restaurant's menu blowing up in the local market. Pulls creator and trend signals. Drafts 3 shoppable video scripts per morning that end with an explicit buy-now / shop-in-bio prompt. Pushes product drafts to the commerce engine for human approval. Never posts, spends, or publishes without approval. Runs a saved routine while the owner is away.

browser_takeover.notes: Owner signs in once per platform via the Grok Bot browser takeover window. The session cookie is stored securely by Grok Bot and reused for subsequent scans. Re-authentication is only required if the session expires or is revoked.
